breaking.change: A `poly` point's `bulge` is now in half-chords, as DXF and CAD polylines give it (1 is a half circle; 0.3 on a 370 mm edge rises 55.5 mm). It was the arch's rise in mm, so the fractions an author writes arched nothing visible.
breaking.fix: Divide an old bulge by half its edge's length: an edge of length L with bulge s (mm) becomes s / (L / 2).
